summary: Gewürzhaus is a family-owned Melbourne spice and gourmet retailer that opened its first store in Carlton in 2010 and now describes itself as an omni-channel retailer. A May 2026 case study reports online sales up 36.1% and store footprint up 45% between FY23 and FY25. CFO Jessica Layton shared the company's AI-focused Technology Manager and HR Manager roles in mid-2026.

claims.text: The same case study says staff grew 9% and the store footprint increased by 45% between FY23 and FY25.
The case study positions Gewürzhaus as a modern omni-channel retailer blending in-store experience with digital engagement.
In Oct 2024 Jessica reposted roles for Gewürzhaus's new SA store, opening soon.
claims.quote: Store Manager and other key roles in our new SA store, opening soon!

claims.text: In Jul 2025 Jessica reposted a Buyer role at Gewürzhaus.
claims.quote: We have a great opportunity for a Buyer in the early stages

hooks.text: Jessica reposted the AI-focused Technology Manager role: appetite for tooling and AI.
Store footprint up 45% and online sales up 36.1% (FY23-FY25): POS, online and inventory reconciliations multiply.
Ongoing hiring (HR, buyer, store roles) shows scale-up pressure.

risks.text: Jessica's public activity is mostly reposts of hiring posts; no finance-specific content found. Data providers disagree on headcount and her exact title history.

gaps: No posts by Jessica on finance topics; accounting system (Xero/MYOB/NetSuite) and POS/Shopify stack not confirmed; no finance job ad found.
